en.explanation:
Given, curve y = x2 + 4

and, line y = 4x 1

Here, y = x2 + 4


..... (i)

and y = 4x 1

..... (ii)

Let the required point be P(x1, y1).

..... (iii)

Slopes will be equal.

2x1 = 4 [from Eqs. (ii) and (iii)]



Now, the given point P(x1, y1) lies on curve y = x2 + 4,

y1 = x + 4

y1 = 22 + 4 = 8

Hence, required coordinate of P = (2, 8)
